item.title: T minus 8 minutes
item.description: 4:56 PM. A sharp pulse hammers behind my right eye every time I look at the screen. I press the heel of my palm hard into my temple, clenching my jaw until my teeth ache. The PowerPoint is due at 5:00 PM on the dot. 4:58 PM. Slack notifications keep stacking in the corner. Erika: ping Erika: where is it? Erika: the boss is joining now My fingers are sweating on the trackpad.

item.title: JWST finally found why the universe is expanding at an accelerating rate...
